bullets.title: NVDA: Beat/raise widely expected for Wed earnings; options implying ~5-8% move; multiple near decade-lows
bullets.body: Consensus is for NVDA to beat Q2 (~$94-95B vs buyside, vs $92.3B FactSet) and raise to ~$107-108B for October; JPM and Oppenheimer are tactically bullish, noting 16x 2027E and 14.7x 2028E vs 5-year avg 32x. Jefferies prefers MRVL over NVDA given funding circularity risks (NVDA-backstopped $500B AI lending). Separately, NVDA has fallen 7 consecutive days (longest streak since 2022), SemiAnalysis flags Rubin Ultra shipping 192GB HBM4 8-hi (down from 1TB preview), and Taiwan prosecutors indicted 9 including NVDA/SMCI employees for alleged chip smuggling. Citi vol desk flags NVDA implied move at 8-quarter lows; SMH realized vol at 78th pct but options skew bullish.

bullets.title: MRVL: Rosenblatt initiates Buy $300 PT; JPM tactically bullish on Google partnership expansion
bullets.body: Rosenblatt initiates MRVL at Buy, raising PT to $300 from $240 (31% upside); analyst Sajal Dogra. JPM notes MRVL AI custom ASIC business expected to double to $4B by F28, with Google partnership expansion worth ~$20B p.a. vs buyside $12B expectation; buyside survey expects 15% sequential / 39% YoY revenue growth and 12% guide raise. Jefferies still prefers MRVL over NVDA and AVGO. MRVL reports Thursday Aug 27 with $2.72B revenue consensus.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Morgan Stanley raises PT to $400 on $200B TPU revenue opportunity; launches Gemini Enterprise verticals
bullets.body: MS raises GOOGL OW PT to $400 on revised TPU 1P sale estimates of ~$27B/GW at 30% GMs (vs $20B prior); models $84B/$108B Cloud revenue in 2027/2028 from TPU sales, with Cloud reaching ~50% of GOOGL EBIT by 2028. Google Cloud also launched Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services and Legal with Moody's as launch partner for the financial product. Hedgeye downgraded GOOGL signal to Bearish with range $339-352.

bullets.title: AMD: Raymond James upgrades to Strong Buy, raises PT to $641 (40% upside); breaks 30% x86 PC share
bullets.body: Raymond James upgraded AMD to strong buy from outperform, raising PT to $641 from $565, implying 40% upside from $456.75 (analyst Simon Leopold). AMD now controls 30%+ of x86 PC CPU market for first time and 46.4% of server CPU market vs Intel's 53.6%. At Hot Chips, AMD MI455X features 432GB HBM4 with 23.3 TB/s bandwidth; Helios double-wide rack architecture power consumption approaching Vera Rubin levels.

bullets.title: INTU: UBS models FY27 GBSG growth 12.9% vs Street 14%; margin expansion 190bps; reports today after close
bullets.body: UBS desk flags INTU FY27 GBSG growth likely 12.9% vs consensus 14% with margin expansion ~190bps vs ~90bps consensus. Citi Buy with $457 PT (23.5% upside); investor poll shows weighted-average FY27 revenue growth expectation of 10.9%, broadly in-line with consensus but risks of reset downward given mgmt commentary on low-end tax market monetization, Mailchimp, and QB Desktop headwinds. INTU reports Tuesday Aug 25 after close with $4.27B revenue consensus.

bullets.title: SNOW: Citi raises PT to $395, KeyBanc to $375; CoCo momentum strong but Databricks gap widening
bullets.body: Citi raises SNOW PT to $395 (from unspecified prior), expects Q2 beat >4% with 2pt+ FY27 raise; AI contributing ~7pts growth in FY27. KeyBanc raises PT to $375 from $325; NTM spend intentions improved to 14% growth from 7% last quarter, but 0% of survey respondents cite Snowflake as more strategic vs Databricks. CoCo adoption cutting enterprise migration timelines in half.

bullets.title: DELL & HPE: JPM raises PTs ahead of earnings on AI server + infrastructure strength
bullets.body: JPM raises DELL PT to $565 (from $550), forecasting FY27 EPS of ~$20 (+85-95% y/y) on 80%+ y/y AI server growth and 30%+ non-AI infrastructure growth; HPE PT raised to $70 (from $68) on Mythos refresh, Juniper cost synergies, and DCI networking strength. JPM also places NTAP on negative catalyst watch despite raising PT to $195 (from $175), citing tough setup at >20x NTM.

bullets.title: CSCO: Morgan Stanley OW $135; navigating supply constraints better than peers; campus refresh early cycle
bullets.body: MS maintains CSCO at OW with $135 PT, noting the company is navigating supply constraints better via balance sheet and larger TSMC commitments, with TSMC volumes expected to increase 10x in FY27. Campus refresh still early (~7% of Catalyst 4K/6K installed base refreshed). CIEN also highlighted as benefitting from pump-laser strength and long-haul optical demand driven by power constraints.

bullets.title: META: Launching Hatch AI agent platform in coming weeks; next model 'Watermelon' targeted October
bullets.body: Meta plans consumer version of its OpenClaw AI agent ('Hatch') in late August/early September with a premium tier at $199.99/month; next AI model 'Watermelon' targeted for October. Hedgeye downgraded META signal to Bearish with range $525-583.

bullets.title: BABA: Chairman Tsai buys 720K shares at $118.47; HK$80B placement 3x oversubscribed
bullets.body: Alibaba chairman Joseph Tsai disclosed purchase of 720K ordinary shares at $118.47, bringing beneficial ownership to ~117.1M shares. BABA's HK stock placement was ~3x oversubscribed and priced at 112.7 HKD; insiders Cai Chongxin and Wu Yongming also bought 120M HKD of stock post-placement. Alibaba also released video generation model Wan 3.0 and launched an AliExpress AI merchant agent.

bullets.title: TSLA: Raises Cybertruck prices 6-7% ($5K each); Semi factory Nevada inauguration next month
bullets.body: Tesla raised Cybertruck Standard AWD to $74,990 and Premium AWD to $84,990, up ~6-7% to reduce per-unit losses at ~15K volume. Tesla Semi factory inauguration planned for Nevada next month. Hedgeye maintains TSLA at Bearish with range $322-365.

bullets.title: INTC: Showcases Diamond Rapids, Crescent Island GPU, Wildcat Lake at Hot Chips; SK Hynix picks EMIB packaging
bullets.body: Intel unveiled Diamond Rapids (256 cores, 18A-P), Crescent Island inference GPU (32 Xe3P cores, up to 480GB LPDDR5X), and Wildcat Lake (NPU 17 TOPS) at Hot Chips. SK Hynix confirmed use of Intel's EMIB advanced packaging for next-gen HBM amid continued TSMC CoWoS capacity constraints, a significant win for Intel. INTC x86 market share falls to 1995 levels vs AMD's gains.

bullets.title: HOOD: Mizuho calls cleanest crypto inflection play on record 40% spot share; crypto rally running on spot demand
bullets.body: Mizuho calls HOOD the cleanest crypto inflection play on record 40% spot retail share in 2Q26 with best-in-class operating leverage. Spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled ~$1.9B weekly inflows; current crypto rally running on spot/ETF demand rather than leveraged shorts.

bullets.title: MU: Hot Chips warns memory wall widening; Mizuho cuts PT to $1,300; HBM hybrid bonding delayed to HBM5
bullets.body: MU warned at Hot Chips that AI compute performance triples every two years while HBM bandwidth grows less than twofold; HBM failures account for ~17% of unintended training interruptions in Meta's Llama 3. SK Hynix confirmed hybrid bonding delayed to HBM5 (2029-30), capping HBM4E stacks at 775 microns. Mizuho cuts MU PT to $1,300 from $1,375 on memory de-spec and WFE uncertainty.

bullets.title: AVGO: CDS at all-time highs; credit risk rising as AI debt financing backstops expand
bullets.body: Broadcom CDS widened to new all-time highs, with NVDA CDS also at record wide levels daily, per market commentary. UBS flags Broadcom credit risk rising as AI debt financing backstops expand; NVDA all-in credit exposure forecast ~$200B by CY28-end per Morgan Stanley.

bullets.title: WBD/PSKY: Paramount exploring WBD asset acquisition; considering Comedy Central purchase
bullets.body: Parties considering options for WBD assets including New Line Cinema and Warner Bros. cable TV networks; sources suggest potential offer to buy Comedy Central from Paramount (PSKY). If Paramount completes WBD purchase, it plans separate distribution agreements with cable companies to address antitrust. WBD flattish in premarket, PSKY up 0.8%.

bullets.title: NFLX: Wolfe raises PT to $95; 2Q weakness content-timing driven, 3Q content slate stronger
bullets.body: Wolfe raises NFLX PT from $84 to $95 on 22x 2028 EPS of $4.41; 2Q subscriber growth of ~900K was worst in years but attributed to content-release timing not structural weakness. Shows with new 3Q seasons had prior-season viewership of 1.3B hrs vs 765M for 2Q launches. NFLX remains Bullish per Hedgeye with range $76-82.

bullets.title: AMZN: Raising Echo/Kindle/Fire TV prices up to 60% on AI memory shortage; developing 'Tetromino' AI warehouse
bullets.body: Amazon is raising Echo, Kindle, and Fire TV hardware prices up to 60% citing AI memory shortage; simultaneously developing Project Tetromino—fully AI-automated warehouse delivery stations with ~$530M investment through 2030. Hedgeye maintains AMZN at Bullish with range $254-272.

bullets.title: AAPL: New Mac mini launch imminent ahead of September iPhone event; Hedgeye upgrades to Bullish
bullets.body: Apple planning Mac mini launch within days, ahead of the September iPhone event. Hedgeye upgraded AAPL from Neutral to Bullish with buy level $299, sell level $318.

bullets.title: Software sector under pressure: NOW, CRM, HUBS, TEAM, ADBE down 2-2.5% premarket
bullets.body: Software stocks broadly weaker in premarket trading: Salesforce -2.1%, ServiceNow -2.0%, HubSpot -2.5%, Atlassian -2.3%, Adobe -1.9%. IGV -2.2% YTD vs S&P +12.9% YTD. Semis supply chain names broadly higher (MRVL +3.3%, MU +2.7%, COHR +3.6%, STX +2.9%) as market rotates.
